skills.name: Nature's Revival
skills.description: Immediately recovers HP equal to 30% of Gaiya's max HP for all allies. For the next 8s, the recovery effect of Grace Domain is doubled, and DMG taken by all allies is reduced by 30%; self is immune to Control effects for the duration.

upgrades.level2: Recovers HP equal to 40% of Gaiya's max HP.
upgrades.level3: All allies take 40% reduced DMG for the duration.
upgrades.level4: Recovers HP equal to 50% of Gaiya's max HP.

skills.name: Overgrown Thorns
skills.description: Deals DMG equal to 200% of ATK to surrounding enemies and reduces the ATK of hit enemies by 20% for 5s. For each enemy hit, self gains a Shield that absorbs DMG equal to 10% of max HP for 8s.

upgrades.level3: Reduces the ATK of hit enemies by 30%.
upgrades.level4: For each enemy hit, self gains a Shield that absorbs DMG equal to 12% of max HP.

skills.name: Grace Domain
skills.description: Gaiya deploys Grace Domain at the start of the battle. All allies recover HP equal to 2% of Gaiya's Max HP per second, and the Heal and Shield effects they receive are increased by 15%.

upgrades.level2: All allies recover HP equal to 3% of Gaiya's Max HP per second.
upgrades.level3: Heal and Shield effects received are increased by 20%.
upgrades.level4: Gaiya recovers HP equal to 5% of her Max HP per second while in Grace Domain.

skills.name: Nature's Armor
skills.description: Gaiya increases max HP by 10% in battle. Each time an Ultimate is cast, max HP is additionally increased by 5%, up to 5 stacks.

upgrades.level2: Gaiya increases max HP by 15% in battle.
upgrades.level3: Each time an Ultimate is cast, max HP is additionally increased by 6%.
upgrades.level4: Gaiya increases max HP by 20% in battle.

relic.name: Life Flora
relic.description: Overhealing from Heal received by Gaia is auto-stored. Generates a "Flower of Life" for every 50% of Max HP overhealed. When any ally is near death, consumes a "Flower of Life" to recover HP stored in the "Flower of Life" to them.

upgrades.level2: For every ally protected by Grace Domain on the field, DMG taken by Gaia is reduced by 6%, up to 5 stacks.
upgrades.level3: For every ally protected by Grace Domain on the field, DMG taken by Gaia is reduced by 9%, up to 5 stacks.
upgrades.level4: For every 3 "Flowers of Life" generated, the next Heal causing Overhealing equal to 50% of Max HP generates a "Flower of Energy", recovering 400 Energy to the ally with the highest ATK and increasing their ATK by 40% for 6s.
